abstract: In the present study 32 extragonadal tumours, reported in 38 years (1956 to 1994) from the department of pathology, Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore were analysed. These were seen predominantly in infants and children mainly affecting females. The commonest sites of these tumours were sacrococcygeal region (46.88%) followed by retroperitoneum and mediastinum. The rarest sites were mesentery, fallopian tube and suprasellar region in the cranial cavity. Histologically 27 out of 32 cases were teratomas, 75% of which were benign.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、マンガロールのカスツルバ医科大学病理学部門で1956年から1994年の38年間に報告された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍32例を解析した。これらは主に乳幼児および小児に認められ、女性に多くみられた。好発部位は仙尾部（46.88%）で、続いて後腹膜、縦隔であった。稀な部位は腸間膜、卵管、頭蓋腔内の鞍上部であった。組織学的には32例中27例が奇形腫で、そのうち75%は良性であった。
